outcomes: The fixed finalizer and 41-file dependency closure are authenticated before non-builtin evaluation.
The actual pure builder validates root authorization, successful stage-one completion, current admission and source/route lineage.
Six exclusive files preserve exact input bytes and PINS; the final layout contains sixteen files and an empty controller directory.
Write, sync, close, readback, clock and source/trust failures retain partial evidence and report STOP with completed-write counts.
A control removing the final recheck falsely finalizes changed package bytes; the original refuses.
Whole CLI pending publication stays nonzero; success followed by a stream error remains nonzero after a repeated callback.
limits: One actual Windows profile uses synthetic history, admission, root approval and stage-one facts; it is not actual private preparation or host evidence.
The ten-second budget is cooperative and cannot preempt blocking filesystem calls.
Point checks do not prove race immunity; a retained PINS or six files alone never proves successful finalization.
Focused tests do not exhaust every path alias, profile, stdout error, filesystem race or malformed argument.
Actual root observation, fresh admission and separately issued GO remain required before host execution.
next: Prepare and independently review actual private stage-one inputs, then obtain fresh admission and a separate bounded metadata GO.
